sources.summary: Antwerp-based gallery Uppercut is presenting the works of six contemporary designers in the ornate halls and salons of a neo-gothic villa near Bruges. Elaborate glass vessels by Danish designer Alexander Kirkeby and melted polystyrene furniture by French designer Nicolas Zanoni are among the pieces on show inside the rooms of the 19th-century Chateau de Spycker The post Uppercut unveils summer exhibition in the stately rooms of Chateau de Spycker appeared first on Dezeen .
